Hair growth supplements for men `typically combine vitamins, minerals, and plant-based DHT-blockers (dihydrotestosterone)` to support thinning hair, though clinical evidence for single-ingredient supplements is limited compared to FDA-approved options like minoxidil or finasteride.[[1]](https://www.amazon.com/Nutrafol-Growth-Supplements-1-Month-Bottle/dp/B00LTZEEGQ)[[2]](https://www.mdhair.co/products/regrowth-supplements)[[3]](https://www.goodrx.com/conditions/hair-loss/best-hair-supplements-for-men)

- **Nutrafol Men Hair Growth Supplements:** Physician-formulated blend targeting 6 root causes of thinning (including stress and hormones like DHT) with 21 vitamins, minerals, and botanical extracts; takes 3 to 6 months for visible results.[[1]](https://www.amazon.com/Nutrafol-Growth-Supplements-1-Month-Bottle/dp/B00LTZEEGQ)
- **BosleyMD Healthy Hair Growth Supplements For Men:** Contains biotin, niacin, zinc, and pumpkin seed extract (which acts as a natural DHT-blocker).[[1]](https://shop.bosley.com/products/bosleymd-healthy-hair-growth-supplements-for-men)
- **Viviscal Man:** Drug-free formula built around the AminoMar collagen complex, vitamin C, zinc, and horsetail extract to support hair density.[[1]](https://www.amazon.com/Viviscal-Supplements-Drug-Free-Alternative-Treatment/dp/B085S7H7K1)
- **MDhair Regrowth Supplements:** Dermatologist-formulated with saw palmetto, pygeum bark, ashwagandha, and vitamins/minerals to address genetic thinning and stress-related shedding.[[1]](https://www.mdhair.co/products/regrowth-supplements)

### Key Ingredients to Look For

- **Saw Palmetto & Pumpkin Seed Extract:** May help block 5-alpha-reductase, the enzyme that converts testosterone into hair-thinning DHT.[[1]](https://www.goodrx.com/conditions/hair-loss/best-hair-supplements-for-men)[[2]](https://www.mdhair.co/products/regrowth-supplements)
- **Ashwagandha:** An adaptogen that helps regulate cortisol and reduce stress-induced hair shedding.[[1]](https://www.mdhair.co/products/regrowth-supplements)
- **Biotin (Vitamin B7) & Zinc:** Essential for keratin structure and follicle repair, though mostly effective if a dietary gap exists.[[1]](https://ishrs.org/patients/treatments-for-hair-loss/nutrition-and-vitamins/)[[2]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=6MTbtvqSypI&vl=en-US)
- **Vitamin D & Iron:** Support cellular turnover and follicle oxygenation; low levels are frequently linked to increased shedding.[[1]](https://health.clevelandclinic.org/the-best-vitamins-supplements-and-products-for-healthier-hair)[[2]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=6MTbtvqSypI&vl=en-US)

### Proven Medical Alternatives

- **Finasteride (Propecia):** Prescription oral or topical medication that stops DHT production at the root cause of male-pattern baldness.[[1]](https://www.goodrx.com/conditions/hair-loss/best-hair-supplements-for-men)
- **Minoxidil (Rogaine):** Over-the-counter topical foam or solution that stimulates blood flow and prolongs the hair growth cycle.[[1]](https://www.goodrx.com/conditions/hair-loss/best-hair-supplements-for-men)

- Are you noticing **receding at the hairline** or **thinning at the crown**?
- Are you open to **prescription options** (like finasteride) or do you prefer **drug-free/over-the-counter** supplements?
- What is your **target budget** per month?
